tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: CGC Airport Transfers service facts: contact, hours, inclusions and policies.

tools.name: get_transfer_quote
tools.description: Get CGC Airport Transfers fixed prices for a trip between two Gold Coast / Brisbane / Northern Rivers locations. Returns per-vehicle AUD fares, GST and tolls included, honoured at booking. If the route is not fixed-price it is quoted per km at booking.

pickup.description: Pickup suburb, hotel or airport (e.g. "Surfers Paradise", "Gold Coast Airport")

tools.name: list_fixed_routes
tools.description: List every CGC Airport Transfers fixed-price route (zones, suburbs and per-vehicle fares).

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Open the CGC booking form pre-filled with trip details. This only navigates to the form — a human reviews the quote and completes the booking and payment themselves. No charge is made by this tool.

vehicle.description: Optional vehicle: sedan (1-3 pax), carnival (up to 7), carnival-rav (up to 9), 2-carnivals (up to 14). Larger vehicles are quoted on request by phone.
